review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. WDFW/DFO sources support surf-zone habitat and a broad reported water-temperature range; numeric preferred SST remains unvalidated.

profile.size: Min limit None / Bag limit 12-15 per harvester / day
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for redtail surfperch.
factors.value_notes: DFO's Pacific species account reports redtail surfperch from 7-19 °C, with a likely colder lower limit than recorded. This is a broad occurrence range, not a preferred SST curve; the configured 8-16 °C range and 10-14 °C ideal remain unvalidated as suitability or catch-probability intervals.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for redtail surfperch.
factors.value_notes: WDFW and DFO describe redtail surfperch primarily in the surf zone on exposed sandy beaches, with use of estuaries/bays and reported shallow depth to about 7 m. This supports the 1-15 m shallow coastal band but does not validate the 3-10 m ideal as a measured preference.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.
